class_name: 疑問-問いかけ-タッケ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: was it …?; what was it again?
patterns.usage_note: Checks a half-remembered fact, either with the listener or out loud with yourself (集合は明日だっけ、あの店の名前なんだっけ). The sibling lane is inward reminiscence about past experience, stated rather than asked (よく通ったっけ). It follows the plain past (行ったっけ / 読んだっけ) or attaches straight to a noun for present facts; the polite forms are でしたっけ and ましたっけ.

examples.ruby: 明日[あした]の集合[しゅうごう]場所[ばしょ]は駅[えき]の北口[きたぐち]だっけ。
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting spot is the station's north exit, right?

examples.ruby: あの分厚[ぶあつ]い小説[しょうせつ]、君[きみ]はもう読[よ]んだっけ。
examples.english: That doorstop of a novel — did you already read it, or am I misremembering?

examples.ruby: あの角[かど]のラーメン屋[や]、名前[なまえ]なんて言[い]ったっけ。
examples.english: That ramen place on the corner — what was it called again?
